ambiguity.phrase: That arrival can trigger Remora’s retrieval.
ambiguity.possible_problem: Read in isolation, “arrival” can refer to reaching the warp and suggest that warp entry itself is Remora’s trigger. The frozen Remora section instead gives retrieval by another player as the ship-retrieval trigger.
ambiguity.contextual_resolution: The question asks about Healer’s retrieval, the immediately preceding sentence describes Healer returning ships after warp entry, and the explicitly linked complete quotation describes the same healing sequence as allowing Remora’s retrieval trigger. In this full context, “can trigger” is reasonably a compressed causal account of that actual-loss-and-healing sequence. It does not expressly instruct Remora to retrieve upon warp entry independently of Healer’s retrieval, nor give an earlier timing window. I therefore treat this as ambiguous/imprecise phrasing rather than a material contradictory ruling. This conclusion rests on the whole-entry meaning; a definite claim that warp entry alone triggers Remora would be false and would not be cured by a correct quotation.
